snippet.title: Fool King Full Announce trailer
snippet.description:
Roll - Plan - Fight - Upgrade
The eternal Fool King has ruled tyranically over Everdawn for centuries

You must raise a rebellion and wage war across the land to eventually overthrow them at the Black Citadel and restore 'peace' to the land

Fool King early prototype now available on itch - https://lootdonkey.itch.io/fool-king
